label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
Rick, I need you to hear me out because I’m really pissed about this.

You told Gary I’d list his house for 1% as a “family rate” without ever asking me. My listing side is 2.5%, and I never agreed to 1%. I spent about six hours on Saturday pulling comps, walking through the house and putting together a full listing packet, on top of driving down from north Phoenix.

I’m not mad at Gary for choosing someone else. That’s his decision. But when I called you and you said, “That’s business, sis, can’t win ’em all,” it felt like you completely brushed off the time I put in and the fact that you made a promise for me in the first place.

This isn’t the first time, either. The same thing happened with your softball friend a couple of years ago, and I let it go. It feels like you get to look like the big shot with your friends while I’m the one doing hours of work for free.

And now you’ve given Denise my number so she can “pick my brain.” I’m not calling Denise. You can tell her that.

From now on, please don’t give out my number or quote my commission to anyone without asking me first. Every time. I’m happy to help actual family—Mom, your kids, whoever—with advice at no charge. But you don’t get to offer my time or set my rates for your friends and coworkers.

I love you, and I’m still looking forward to Thanksgiving at your place. But I need you to take this seriously and stop putting me in this position.
